checkTheName.name: Check the name
checkTheName.description: Write a `handleGuest` function that checks whether the person's name starts with the allowed letters for tonight's party. Return `true` if it does, or `false` if it doesn't.

sarahSParty.name: S Party: Sarah arrives
sarahSParty.description: Tonight only names starting with "S" are allowed. Sarah should get in!

bradSParty.name: S Party: Brad arrives
bradSParty.description: Tonight only names starting with "S" are allowed. Brad should be turned away.

bradleyBradParty.name: Brad Party: Bradley arrives
bradleyBradParty.description: Tonight only names starting with "Brad" are allowed. Bradley should get in!

brianBradParty.name: Brad Party: Brian arrives
brianBradParty.description: Tonight only names starting with "Brad" are allowed. Brian should be turned away.

silence.name: S Party: Silence...
silence.description: The person doesn't say their name. An empty name can't start with anything. Turn them away!

cherCherParty.name: Cher Party: Cher arrives
cherCherParty.description: Tonight only names starting with "Cher" are allowed. Cher's name is exactly "Cher" — let her in!

useTheInputs.question: How do I use the name and the allowed prefix?
useTheInputs.answer: They're passed into your `handleGuest` function as inputs, so you can use `name` and `allowedPrefix` directly in your comparison.

checkStartsWith.question: How do I check that a name starts with certain letters?
checkStartsWith.answer: Compare each character of the allowed prefix with the character at the same position in the name. If any character differs, the name doesn't match.

loopCharacters.question: How do I look at one character at a time?
loopCharacters.answer: Use a counter variable and step through each position with a loop, comparing `name` and `allowedPrefix` at that position.

stopComparing.question: How do I know when to stop comparing?
stopComparing.answer: Stop when you've checked every character of the allowed prefix. You'll need its length for that, similar to what you did in Sign Painter Price.

longerAllowedPrefix.question: What if the allowed prefix is longer than the name?
longerAllowedPrefix.answer: That person can't match, so you should return `false`. Check the lengths before you start comparing and handle that case.
